name: 49502-subblockturns-4b-1gpu
hardware: 1x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3, plus host DRAM for the shared KV store that runs beside the engine on the same node.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1. One in-process engine, one node. A Mooncake distributed store is configured as a KV connector in kv_both, so the engine both writes into the pool and reads from it.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=512, warmup 20%, cooldown 10%, 3072 requests bounded, safety_seconds 1800. Both phases pinned to `mode: requests`.
workload: Sub-block multi-turn chat, text only: 512 conversations of 6 user turns (3072 requests, so every stream runs one whole conversation), each opening on one of 8 shared 64-token contexts, 48-token user turns, exactly 1 output token per turn, greedy (temperature 0.0). Each turn re-sends the conversation so far, so rendered prompts run from roughly 130 tokens at the first turn to about 430 at the sixth.
purpose: A 4B-parameter chat assistant serving 512 concurrent six-turn conversations that begin from eight shared openings, single-token replies, one GPU.
launch:
# 49502-subblockturns-4b-1gpu -- the launch config, in `vllm serve --config` form.
#
# `kv-transfer-config` MUST stay on ONE line: the reader that turns this file into engine arguments
# drops any line beginning with a space, so a nested mapping is silently discarded and the engine
# starts with no connector at all.

model: Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B
tensor-parallel-size: 1
max-model-len: 1024
max-num-batched-tokens: 2048

# Not a restatement of a default: prefix caching is opt-in for hybrid checkpoints at this commit,
# so deleting this key would serve the workload with no prefix reuse of any kind.
enable-prefix-caching: true

enable-chunked-prefill: true
mamba-cache-mode: align
prefix-match-unit: 16
kv-transfer-config: {"kv_connector":"MooncakeStoreConnector","kv_role":"kv_both"}
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.35
max-num-seqs: 128
